descriptionByLocale.it: Le tue missioni: consigli, servi i nostri clienti e conduci colloqui di vendita impegnativi. - Ordini la merce e sei responsabile della gestione. - Progetti esperienze di acquisto focalizzate su prodotti e servizi. - Sei specializzato in un campo che hai scelto. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your missions - You advise, serve our customers and conduct demanding sales interviews. - You order the goods and you are responsible for management. - You design purchasing experiences focused on products and services. - You specialize in a field that you have chosen. What is expected of you - Ability to work in a team and ease in contacts - Organizational skills and flexibility - Willingness to be autonomous and take responsibility - Pleasure in evolving within a dynamic company - Communication skills - Salesmanship
• What we offer you - Annual “update Fitness” subscription - CHF 500 for the purchase of a laptop or tablet - 50% on the Coop package Mobile Start - Half-price subscription or contribution of 650 CHF to the purchase of SBB AG - Lots of other advantages! Jonathan Capelli HR Professional training Choose Your Character - Create Your Future: Build your future with the learning that suits you. Coop offers a large number of apprenticeship places and further education opportunities.
